F1: The optimized paginator applies floor/ceil directly to datetime values and lacks DateTimePaginator’s cursor conversion.
F2: The endpoint dereferences optional `member` even when optimized pagination was not requested.
F3: Advanced pagination passes negative offsets into queryset slicing, which raises `ValueError` rather than `BadPaginationError`.
F4: The changed code uses sorted-set commands on the existing segment keys, so legacy set-backed buffers cause Redis `WRONGTYPE` errors.
